tool_input.prompt: What is the latest React version and its release date? Is 19.3 the latest?

tool_result_content:
Yes, according to the page, React 19.3 is the latest version. The "Latest version" heading lists 19.3, and the changelog gives its release as **v19.3.0, September 9, 2026**, with a corresponding blog post at `/blog/2026/09/09/react-19-3`.

The docs at react.dev cover the latest major version, so 19 is the current major. Previous majors are archived at 18.react.dev, 17.react.dev, and so on.

I can only confirm this from the page content. For the authoritative release notes, check the React blog or the [CHANGELOG on GitHub](https://github.com/react/react/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).
